A2_duplicates.cause: _export_per_frame_run_catalog_core did not call _proc_deduplicate_matched_catalog_rows before write; alternate export path did. Multiple DAO detections match same Gaia id.
A2_duplicates.forced_photometry_role: not the cause (duplicate rows have forced_photometry=False)

D2_aperture_vs_psf.finding: Median aperture equals snr_table r_min_px (clamp). Production radius is SNR-table sized, not aperture_fwhm_factor*FWHM. Phase2A FWHM~3.3 px feeds the SNR table; AUTO FWHM~5.3 and proc fwhm_estimate~6.1 are different estimators. If moment FWHM is closer to true seeing, EE at r_min is ~42 percent and aperture losses vary with seeing.
